entities.summary: Anglo-Irish soldier and statesman Arthur Wellesley (1769–1852), 1st Duke of Wellington, whose defeat of Napoleon at Waterloo in 1815 ended the Napoleonic Wars. Previously distinguished in India at Assaye and in the Peninsular War in Spain, he later served as Prime Minister. His defensive mastery — choosing ground, using reverse slopes, and disciplined infantry — defined British military doctrine.
